summary: The smoke marker arm-registry line is not in the required structured or N/A form.
Fits can consume a partial HF capture prefix without checking capture_done, capture_meta, exact chunks, or row totals.
Bootstrap layer reselection uses TEST residuals instead of validation-based selection.
Gen and capture validate persisted producer records after initializing vLLM/HF models.
P4 writes primary results only to ephemeral pod-local paths and never publishes or writes p4_done.
Remote gen/capture skips and fits post resume can reuse outputs from incompatible parameters.
A conflicting VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER value survives setdefault while the script reports pins OK.
Production serializes layer and LODO dense fits and substitutes an unapproved streamed helper.
Distinct completions are unchecked and definitive decisions can be emitted without reliability ceilings.
P0 filters only with Qwen2.5 and permits later model-specific drops.
The >2% cap-hit branch warns but neither regenerates capped rows nor halts before capture.
P5 substitutes err-vs-SST for the approved predicted-vs-true first-PC scatter.
PASS_PARTIAL leaves real Model-B load, GDN prefill, and vLLM generation uncertified.
Fits lack a production-n per-call timing extrapolation against the four-hour plan.
